verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'We have liftoff' on April 1; R3: post-splashdown confirms launch; R5: 'lifted off at 3:35 p.m. Pacific time' (6:35 ET April 1)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm successful launch on exact date.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first crewed flight to the Moon in over half a century.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first time humans have traveled beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years. The last mission to do so was Apollo 17 in 1972'; similar in others
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated across sources since Apollo 17 (1972).

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'more than 600,000-mile, 10-day journey'; R2: '10-day journey'; R3: '10 days around the moon'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is testing the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'test flight... to test critical spacecraft systems'; R2: 'test flight... testing systems'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly a test of Orion spacecraft systems.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission includes four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'send four astronauts'; R2: 'four-astronaut crew'; R3: 'four Artemis 2 astronauts'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II astronauts include the first woman and first Black person to go to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'first Black astronaut, the first woman... to visit the moon'; R1 notes Glover as first Black assigned to lunar mission, Koch records holder
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify Glover (Black) and Koch (woman) as firsts for Moon.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission travels around the lunar far side.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'fly by the far side of the moon'; R2: 'around the far side of the moon'; R3: 'flyby of the moon’s far side'
verifications.reasoning: Explicit far side flyby in all detailed sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission lifted off on a Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Space Launch System (SLS), the rocket'; R5: 'Space Launch System rocket lifted off'

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Kennedy Space Center in Florida at Launch Complex 39B'; R2: 'Kennedy Space Center in Florida... Launch Complex 39B'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew consists of Commander Reid Wiseman, Pilot Victor Glover, Mission Specialists Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen'; exact match
verifications.reasoning: Precise crew list and roles match exactly.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will travel around the far side of the moon.

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Exact event on day 6 from far side.
